name: decionis-commercegate
description: Check a price change, order, refund or return against your commerce policy before an agent acts. Never writes to a marketplace.
long_description:
Decionis CommerceGate lets Claude ask one question before it touches a marketplace: is this allowed under our policy?

It checks seven kinds of commerce action in Shadow Mode: a price change, a stock change, accepting an order, a fulfillment step, a promotion change, a refund, or a return authorization. The answer is PROCEED, HOLD or BLOCK with the math behind it: net margin after landed cost and marketplace fees against your margin floor, quantity against your inventory floor, refund amount against what the order has left to refund. Every policy decision is recorded in a signed Decision Dossier that finance can verify months later.

Ask it things like:
- "Would repricing this SKU to $89 on Walmart still clear our margin floor after the referral fee?"
- "Is it safe to accept this 40-unit order with the stock we have left?"
- "Can the support bot refund $2,850 on this order?"
- "What would Shadow Mode have held this month, and why?"

For Dynamics 365 Business Central, a separate tool returns an enforced ALLOW or BLOCK for one complete transaction within the agent's spend budget.

What it never does: CommerceGate does not accept, ship, cancel, refund, reprice or change stock on any platform. It evaluates and reads evidence; a person or the connected system still executes. A PROCEED is a policy result, not consent.

Capability discovery works with no credentials. Tenant checks need a Decionis API key and organization ID from your Decionis workspace (free Shadow Mode, no time limit).

decionis_api_key.title: Decionis API key
decionis_api_key.description: From your Decionis workspace. Needed for policy checks and evidence reads; leave empty to run in describe-only mode.

decionis_org_id.title: Decionis organization ID
decionis_org_id.description: The organization UUID every policy check is scoped to. Cannot be overridden by a tool call.

decionis_api_base.title: Decionis API origin
decionis_api_base.description: Leave as the default unless Decionis gave you a dedicated origin.

tools.name: commercegate_describe_capabilities
tools.description: What CommerceGate can check, how it answers, and whether it is connected to a workspace. Works without credentials.

tools.name: commercegate_evaluate_action
tools.description: Check a price change, stock change, order acceptance, fulfillment step, promotion change, refund or return against policy in Shadow Mode before acting.

tools.name: commercegate_validate_erp_transaction
tools.description: Enforced ALLOW or BLOCK for one complete Dynamics 365 Business Central transaction within the agent's spend budget.

tools.name: commercegate_get_dossier
tools.description: Read the signed Decision Dossier behind a decision: why it was held, allowed or blocked and under which policy version.

tools.name: commercegate_get_proof_packet
tools.description: Read the proof packet for a dossier when finance or an auditor asks for signed evidence.

tools.name: commercegate_list_shadow_reports
tools.description: List what Shadow Mode would have held or blocked recently, and why.

tools.name: commercegate_summarize_shadow_reports
tools.description: Totals for a period: near misses, policy mismatches and the order value reviewed, to judge whether to turn enforcement on.
